Name: Shelah, Son of Judah
Summary: Shelah was the third son of Judah by the daughter of Shuah, kept back from marrying Tamar after his brothers died.
KeyStory: Shelah survived his brothers and fathered a line of his own, though Judah's promise to give him to Tamar was never kept.
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
